history.summary: TOWN CORRECTION: the CSV town 'Itanagar' is approximate - the temple stands on NH-52A at Banderdewa (Banderdawa, Ranga De-reserve, plus-code 4R4G+P93), about 20+ km from central Itanagar, near the Assam-Arunachal border. The Ganga Jamuna Mandir is a Hindu temple dedicated to the sacred rivers Ganga and Yamuna, serving the migrant Hindu community of the Itanagar capital region. No published construction date or founder could be found; travel guides list darshan 6:00 AM-8:00 PM with free entry.

name: Ganga Jamuna Mandir
town_description: Banderdewa (Banderdawa) is a border checkpoint town on NH-52A/NH-15 in Papum Pare district, the gateway into the Itanagar Capital Complex from the Assam plains. It is a transit hub of markets, transport links and roadside shrines serving travellers and the migrant workforce of the capital region.

travel.road: On NH-52A at Banderdewa (Ranga De-reserve); on the Itanagar-Naharlagun road, reachable by bus, taxi and auto.

visitor_information.best_time: October to March; Ganga Dussehra (June) and Kartik Purnima are the likely festival peaks (verify).
visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-8:00 PM daily, per a travel guide (verify); free entry.
